title: DOW-UAP-D080, Narrative Statement 2, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This is a memorandum for record from the Office of the Under Secretary of War containing firsthand narratives of UAP encounters reported by federal law enforcement agents.

encounters.summary: Witness observed a bright orb-like light expelling smaller red lights that maneuvered in formation over a valley.
encounters.quote: The objects appeared to move with purpose in a coordinated fashion

encounters.summary: Witness observed hovering red lights in a triangular formation and two vehicles that morphed into a single orb-like light and later a box-shaped light formation.
encounters.quote: The object appeared to “toy” with us

encounters.summary: Witness observed an orb-like light on a highway that mimicked vehicle behavior, transitioned between light forms, and disappeared upon the approach of a semi-truck.
encounters.quote: It felt like it was drawing us in and had control to disappear instantly.
